title.zh: 追认菲律宾群岛民政总督指示群岛采购代理向黎刹省马里基纳镇遭受火灾、于1903年4月26日失去住所的灾民提供二万五千磅大米、二千磅鱼及一百顶帐篷之行为的法案。
title.en: AN ACT RATIFYING THE ACTION OF THE CIVIL GOVERNOR OF THE PHILIPPINE ISLANDS IN DIRECTING THE INSULAR PURCHASING AGENT TO FURNISH TO THE SUFFERING INHABITANTS OF THE TOWN OF MARIQUINA, IN THE PROVINCE OF RIZAL, RENDERED HOMELESS BY THE BURNING OF A LARGE PART OF THAT TOWN ON THE TWENTY-SIXTH DAY OF APRIL, NINETEEN HUNDRED AND THREE, TWENTY-FIVE THOUSAND POUNDS OF RICE, TWO THOUSAND POUNDS OF FISH, AND ONE HUNDRED TENTS.
title.orig: AN ACT RATIFYING THE ACTION OF THE CIVIL GOVERNOR OF THE PHILIPPINE ISLANDS IN DIRECTING THE INSULAR PURCHASING AGENT TO FURNISH TO THE SUFFERING INHABITANTS OF THE TOWN OF MARIQUINA, IN THE PROVINCE OF RIZAL, RENDERED HOMELESS BY THE BURNING OF A LARGE PART OF THAT TOWN ON THE TWENTY-SIXTH DAY OF APRIL, NINETEEN HUNDRED AND THREE, TWENTY-FIVE THOUSAND POUNDS OF RICE, TWO THOUSAND POUNDS OF FISH, AND ONE HUNDRED TENTS.
title.vi: Luật phê chuẩn hành động của Thống đốc dân sự Philippines chỉ đạo viên chức mua sắm cấp đảo cung cấp 25.000 pao gạo, 2.000 pao cá và 100 lều cho cư dân thị trấn Mariquina, tỉnh Rizal bị mất nhà do vụ cháy ngày 26 tháng 4 năm 1903.
title.th: กฎหมายรับรองการดำเนินการของผู้ว่าการพลเรือนแห่งหมู่เกาะฟิลิปปินส์ที่สั่งให้เจ้าหน้าที่จัดซื้อของหมู่เกาะจัดส่งข้าว 25,000 ปอนด์ ปลา 2,000 ปอนด์ และเต็นท์ 100 หลังแก่ผู้ประสบภัยในเมือง Mariquina จังหวัด Rizal ซึ่งไร้ที่อยู่อาศัยจากเหตุเพลิงไหม้เมื่อวันที่ 26 เมษายน 1903
title.id: Undang-undang yang mengesahkan tindakan Gubernur Sipil Kepulauan Filipina yang memerintahkan agen pembelian kepulauan menyediakan 25.000 pon beras, 2.000 pon ikan, dan 100 tenda bagi penduduk Mariquina, Provinsi Rizal, yang kehilangan tempat tinggal akibat kebakaran pada 26 April 1903.
title.ms: Akta mengesahkan tindakan Gabenor Awam Kepulauan Filipina yang mengarahkan ejen pembelian kepulauan membekalkan 25,000 paun beras, 2,000 paun ikan dan 100 khemah kepada penduduk Mariquina, Wilayah Rizal, yang kehilangan tempat tinggal akibat kebakaran pada 26 April 1903.

text.en:
Whereas, by order of the Civil Governor of the Philippine Islands, the Insular Purchasing Agent
has furnished gratuitously, through the supervisor of the Province of Rizal, twenty-five thousand pounds of
rice, two thousand pounds of fish, and one hundred tents, to relieve the people of the town of Mariquina who
were rendered homeless by the binning of a large part of that town on the twenty-sixth day of April, nineteen
hundred and three:
Therefore, the action of the Civil Governor of the Philippine Islands in ordering the distribution of these
supplies is hereby confirmed and ratified.

There is hereby appropriated from the fund of three million dollars, m money of the United States,
voted by the Congress of the United States by Act approved the third day of March, nineteen hundred and
three, out of funds not otherwise appropriated from that fund, a sum sufficient to pay the Insular Purchasing
Agent for the supplies thus furnished, in the same manner and at the same prices as if they had been lawfully
furnished to one of the Bureaus or provinces of the Philippine Government.

The public good requiring the speedy enactment of this bill, the passage of the same is hereby
expedited in accordance with section two of "An Act prescribing the order of procedure by the Commission
in the enactment of laws," passed September twenty-sixth, nineteen hundred.

This Act shall take effect on its passage.
Enacted, May 16, 1903.
